title: fix(plugin-grid): a grouped list on a phone draws group headers and cards instead of the desktop table
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8De3eSThgQxB2Vi4oQaNnE7)_
Fixes #26896

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:手机宽度(小于 768px)下,分组列表不再沿用桌面表格,而是和普通列表一样显示卡片,分组标题夹在卡片之间。
- 为什么改:分组列表在手机上标题被截断、其它列被固定的操作列挡住,完全没法读;普通列表早已是卡片。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `ObjectGrid` 的渲染分支,桌面分组表格与普通卡片不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectGrid.tsx` 里新的 `isGrouped && useCardView` 分支与 `buildMobileCardRenderer`;`groupedMobileCards-26896.test.tsx`;`groupingNeedsHeaderQuery-10881.test.tsx` 改写的那条旧断言。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupedMobileCards-26896.test.tsx`,预期 4 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ObjectGrid` lifts the mobile card body out of the plain card branch into one renderer, `buildMobileCardRenderer()`, which returns the per-row card function. The plain card view (ungrouped, under 768px) draws through it unchanged: same scroller, same card markup.
- A grouped view under the same card breakpoint (`isGrouped && useCardView`) now draws `groupBandsOf(pagedGroups)` as a vertical list instead of the grouped table: each band's `GroupRow` (toggle, label, count, aggregations), then that band's rows as cards, then its footer (a server-grouped group's pager or loading line). Collapse, counts, the whole-group pager (`groupedPager`) and server group paging keep working because they are the same bands the table draws.
- At a desktop width the grouped table (one table, one header) is untouched.

## Tests

- New `groupedMobileCards-26896.test.tsx` (4 tests): at 390px a client-grouped view draws one band per group with that group's rows as cards under it and no `table`; collapsing a band removes its cards and keeps the band; the same on the server-grouped path (header query + per-group pages). CONTROL: at 1280px the same view still draws the one grouped table and no card.
- `groupingNeedsHeaderQuery-10881.test.tsx`: its re-homed pin asserted that a grouped grid under 768px draws the table, which is exactly the behaviour this card replaces. It now asserts the five bands, their cards and no table; its ungrouped control is unchanged.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): with `isGrouped && useCardView` replaced by `isGrouped && false` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), the new file goes 3 failed / 1 passed: the three phone tests red, the desktop control green.

## Acceptance notes

- The grouped phone view keeps the page's toolbar and bulk bar (it draws inside the grid's normal frame), while the plain card view keeps its existing early return. Cards carry no selection checkbox in either view, as before.
- Group headers in the card view do not stick to the top while scrolling; the plain card list has no sticky header either.

## Verification

Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run on the final head `8cfdb16a`: 35 derived plus 5 extra (plugin-grid type-check, eslint on the touched files, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:new-line-citations`, the touched test files), all 40 exit 0, exits captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciles 35 derived / 35 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED. Details in the os-dev report on the card. The whole `packages/plugin-grid/` suite ran once before the test update (253/254 files; the one red was the stale pin rewritten above) and the touched files were re-run on the final head.
